title: A pre-norm decoder block
hints: Pre-norm means the LayerNorm is applied to the input of each sub-layer, not to the sum: h = x + mha(ln1(x)).
Pass the mask straight through to mha; the FFN is position-wise and needs no mask.
Second half: out = h + ffn(ln2(h)). Nothing else: no final norm and no dropout in this version.
